verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a dedicated quotas page. It covers viewing quotas in the Cloud Console, reading quota errors when a Node Pool exceeds its quota, and requesting an increase, which together meet the core of the story. Capacity Finder adds visibility into instance placement availability. Missing for 10: specific documented limit values or a quota table, details of the increase-request process (channel, turnaround, approval), programmatic quota access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
